run_chat_interactive: run the hermes CLI interactive chat session with a query or resume a previous session
run_gateway_service: run the messaging gateway as a foreground process or install it as a background systemd/launchd service
run_setup_wizard: run the interactive setup wizard to configure API keys, model provider, and platform integrations
select_provider_model: select an inference provider and default model through an interactive menu with curses navigation
manage_cron_jobs: create, list, pause, resume, and delete scheduled cron jobs that run agent prompts on a timer
manage_profiles: create, delete, list, switch, rename, and export/import isolated Hermes agent profiles
browse_sessions: browse past chat sessions with interactive search, filtering by title, preview, and source
run_doctor_diagnostic: run the doctor diagnostic to check configuration, dependencies, and provider connectivity
update_agent: update Hermes Agent to the latest version via git pull or ZIP fallback with dependency reinstall
run_dashboard_server: start the FastAPI web dashboard for managing config, API keys, and sessions
